tests.scope: CPU contracts, profiling payload identity and all-row failure gates, provenance, existing CUDA helpers, and new production probability/history helpers on SM86. No full Hopper attention execution.
tests.helper_result: All packed P bytes, maximum, alpha, FP32 mass/denominator and output history match baseline exactly in tested cases. Independent PyTorch max, FP8 decode and recurrence also pass.
tests.cases: 1/2/7/296 tiles; random/stable/increasing maxima; extreme-range fallback; lane-specific scales; sparse row updates; nondefault stream. DPX intrinsic uses software compatibility on SM86.

sm90a_cross_compile.scope: Static instruction counts only, not timing. Original instruction texts compared after normalizing the added default template argument; encodings/control words excluded.

h200_validation: Not run locally. Remote script adds 360 dtype/shape/algorithm/mode cases repeated 3 times, 24 uniform-attention known answers and 36 constructed max-update cases before timing.
h200_performance: Not measured. Branch/vote costs and GPU scheduling require measurement; no attention speedup or 22 ms claim.
default_kernel: vc15 unchanged; candidates require explicit selection
